body: **Foco:** Verbo-chave: turn.
**Verbos:** convey.
**Expressões:** to draw a distinction.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (pensamento crítico).
**Texto do dia:** conto e trecho de peça.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar turn e seus sentidos (turn out, turn down, turn into, turn over, turn a blind eye, in turn) num conto, convey e to draw a distinction.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: The Verdict on Paper
paras: Elena had expected the report to **turn out** differently. She **turned over** the last page and frowned: the numbers **turned the whole argument on its head**. Her director would **turn down** the proposal, and she could not **turn a blind eye**.

“I need you **to draw a distinction**,” he said later, “between what the data **convey** and what we wish they said.” She nodded. **In turn**, he thanked her. Tears **turned into** a smile by evening.

items.q: Elena was surprised by the report.
The director will accept the proposal.

items.why: could not turn a blind eye.

blocks.body: **turn** é muito polissêmico. Memorize **combinações completas**: *turn out to be*, *turn a blind eye to*, *in turn*.

items.s: The tests ___ out to be wrong. (turn, past)
The board ___ down the offer. (turn, past)
She will not turn a ___ eye. (blind)
He thanked her, and she, ___ turn, thanked him. (in)

items.ans: Probably I can't turn a blind eye

body: **to draw a distinction** — estabelecer uma distinção
**Turn the tables.** — Inverter a situação.
**Turn a blind eye.** — Fingir não ver.
**Turn over a new leaf.** — Recomeçar.
**Turn the page.** — Virar a página.
**Turn up the heat.** — Aumentar a pressão.
**Do a U-turn.** — Mudar totalmente de rumo.
**At every turn.** — A cada passo.
**Take a turn for the worse.** — Piorar.
**The numbers turned out differently.** — Os números saíram diferentes.
**Will the director turn down the proposal?** — O diretor vai recusar a proposta?
**Probably. I can’t turn a blind eye.** — Provavelmente. Não posso fingir que não vi.

head: Phrasal verb

prompts.model: She helped him, and he helped her in turn.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence story opening using three senses of turn.
blocks.model: Marta had expected the audit to turn out well. She turned over the last page and saw the error. Her manager would turn down the budget, and she could not turn a blind eye. By evening, worry had turned into resolve. She drew a distinction between what she hoped and what the numbers conveyed.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
